name: For Eternity and a Few Minutes
source:
A girl finds herself trapped in an endless midsummer day, an idyllic memory of playing in a field with her best friend. Here, there is no grief, no loss, only warmth. 

But when her best friend, long gone in the real world, appears and pleads with her to remember the truth, the illusion begins to crack.

[From [url=https://reveire.itch.io/for-eternity-and-a-few-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩发现自己陷入了无尽的仲夏夜，与她最好的朋友在田野里玩耍的田园诗般的回忆。在这里，没有悲伤，没有失落，只有温暖。

但当她在现实世界中消失已久的最好的朋友出现并恳求她记住真相时，幻想开始破裂。

[来自[url=https://reveire.itch.io/for-eternity-and-a-few-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
